# Tooltip

A short supplementary label shown on hover and keyboard focus: an icon button's name, the key name behind "8A", the absolute time behind "3 h ago".

`SongNodes.Tooltip` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Tooltip content={…}>…</SongNodes.Tooltip>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Tooltip" content="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Props (TooltipProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content` * | `ReactNode` | Short supplementary text: a name, a key name ("A minor"), an absolute time. Never essential or interactive. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Optional keyboard shortcut shown as a key cap. |
| `children` * | `ReactNode` | The trigger; must be focusable. |
| `delayMs` | `number` | Hover delay in ms (default 500); hiding is immediate. |
| `relation` | `"describe" \| "label"` | How the trigger uses it: "describe" sets aria-describedby; "label" for icon buttons whose aria-label already matches. |
| `side` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Preferred side; flips when there is no room. |
